title: INFRAMIND: Infrastructure-Aware Multi-Agent Orchestration
abstract: arXiv:2606.11440v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems spend additional computation on reasoning and collaboration, but shared serving queues can prevent that computation from producing answers before a deadline. This creates a coupled decision: the reasoning workflow determines the load, while changing load determines which reasoning choices remain affordable. We introduce INFRAMIND, a hierarchical policy that adapts workflow planning and execution to serving conditions. At arrival, a planner selects the collaboration graph using task information, load and the time budget. Before each agent call, an executor jointly selects the model and reasoning strategy using refreshed telemetry and remaining time. A shared latency penalty connects the two policies. Our analysis characterizes why observing load matters when congestion reverses the preferred computation. Across five benchmarks on a shared five-model deployment, INFRAMIND improves low-load accuracy by up to 7.6

translated_title: INFRAMIND：基础设施感知的多智能体编排
translated_abstract: 多智能体LLM系统会在推理和协作上投入额外的计算，但共享的服务队列可能使这些计算无法在截止时间之前产生答案。这形成了一个耦合决策：推理工作流决定了系统负载，而不断变化的负载又决定了哪些推理选择在成本上仍然可行。我们提出了INFRAMIND，一种能够根据服务条件自适应调整工作流规划与执行的层次化策略。在任务到达时，规划器利用任务信息、负载状况和时间预算来选择协作图结构。在每次智能体调用之前，执行器基于最新遥测数据和剩余时间，联合选择模型和推理策略。一个共享的延迟惩罚机制将这两个策略连接起来。我们的分析阐明了当拥塞导致首选计算策略被逆转时，观测负载为何至关重要。在共享五模型部署的五个基准测试中，INFRAMIND将低负载场景下的准确率提升了高达7.6（个百分比点）。
tldr: INFRAMIND提出了一种层次化策略，通过根据实时服务负载、遥测数据和时间预算，动态调整多智能体系统的协作图规划以及模型与推理策略选择，从而在共享部署环境中将准确率提升高达7.6个百分点。
en_tdlr: INFRAMIND is a hierarchical policy that dynamically adapts multi-agent workflow planning (collaboration graph selection) and execution (joint model and reasoning strategy selection) to real-time serving load and time budgets, improving accuracy by up to 7.6 points in shared LLM deployments.
